title: How Fast Chargers Fill Your Phone in Five Minutes! ⚡
description: Charge your phone in mere minutes instead of waiting for hours! Discover the science and tech behind modern fast chargers.

scenes.say: Why does your phone charge in minutes today, while it used to take hours in the past? Let's discover the secret together.

scenes.caption: Five watts
scenes.say: Old chargers pumped energy very slowly at just five watts, because batteries were extremely sensitive.

scenes.label: Modern charger power
scenes.say: Today, some fast chargers reach one hundred twenty watts and more, transferring huge amounts of energy in record time.
But pouring massive power all at once risks overheating and instant damage. How does technology solve this?

scenes.caption: Charger brain
scenes.say: The secret starts with a tiny smart chip inside the phone and charger, negotiating every second to set the right power.

scenes.title: Fast Charging Stages
scenes.say: The charger pumps maximum power when empty, then slows down gradually as the battery nears completion.
Some phones split the battery into two parallel halves, accepting double the power without a dangerous temperature spike.

scenes.caption: Silicon alternative
scenes.say: Fast chargers use an advanced material called gallium nitride instead of traditional silicon to transfer energy more efficiently.

scenes.label: New material efficiency
scenes.say: This material allows higher power to pass with less energy wasted as heat, letting you charge your phone safely.
So fast charging is not just strong electricity, it is a precise engineering dance between software and advanced physics.
